# `Q-9-9` — Missing Required Element

> A CSL element is missing a child element that its schema
> requires.

## What this means

Several CSL elements require specific children. `<cs:style>`
requires `<cs:citation>` and `<cs:info>`; `<cs:citation>`
requires `<cs:layout>`. This error fires when one of those
required children is missing from the parent. The message names
both the parent and the missing child.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A hand-edited style** where the child was deleted by
  mistake.
- **A style copied from a partial snippet** that did not
  include all the required pieces.
- **A misunderstanding of which children are required vs
  optional** — many CSL elements look complete on inspection
  while still missing a required piece.

## How to fix

Add the missing child element inside the parent named in the
message. The CSL specification documents the required children
for every element.

## Related

- `Q-9-7` — required *attribute* missing on an element: the
  same family of error, for the other kind of schema
  requirement.
